## Overview

This notebook plots mean sea surface temperature from the GFDL and IPSL historical simulations, interpolated to a finer grid and clipped to the southern Benguela Atlantis model domain.

## Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(ncdf4)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(akima)
library(ggpubr)
```

## User settings

The netCDF files are not part of the repository (ISIMIP3b inputs, cited).

```{r settings}
# Path to the original gridded ESM netCDF
gfdl_path <- "~/Documents/abacus/Hydro/CMIP6/InputData/gfdl/hist/gfdl-esm4_r1i1p1f1_historical_thetao_60arcmin_cropped_monthly_1850_2014.nc"
ipsl_path <- "~/Documents/abacus/Hydro/CMIP6/InputData/ipsl/hist/ipsl-cm6a-lr_r1i1p1f1_historical_thetao_60arcmin_cropped_monthly_1850_2014.nc"
outpath <- "outputs/figures/"

# Path to the Atlantis domain shapefile (individual polygons)
shp_polygons <- "~/Documents/abacus/abacus_shapefile/boundary/model_region_boundary.shp"

#Years to average over (adjust to your baseline period)
year_start <- 1990
year_end   <- 2009  

# Surface layer index (lev = 1 is the shallowest, 0-2 m)
surface_lev <- 1

# Read model domain boundary
domain_sf <- st_read(shp_polygons, quiet = TRUE)
```

## Read, average, interpolate and clip netCDF (same steps for both ESMs)

```{r sst-function}
sst_domain <- function(nc_path) {
  nc <- nc_open(path.expand(nc_path))

  lon  <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon")
  lat  <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat")
  time <- ncvar_get(nc, "time")

  # Time is in "months since 1601-1-1", calendar 365_day
  # Convert to approximate years
  time_years  <- 1601 + (time - 1) / 12

  # Subset to desired year range
  idx_time <- which(time_years >= year_start & time_years <= year_end)
  cat(basename(nc_path), ": selected", length(idx_time), "months from", year_start, "to", year_end, "\n")

  # Read surface temperature for selected time period
  # thetao dimensions in file: (time, lev, lat, lon)
  # ncvar_get reads as (lon, lat, lev, time) in R due to dimension reversal
  thetao <- ncvar_get(nc, "thetao",
                      start = c(1, 1, surface_lev, idx_time[1]),
                      count = c(length(lon), length(lat), 1, length(idx_time)))
  nc_close(nc)

  # Replace fill values with NA before averaging
  thetao[thetao > 1e19] <- NA

  # Average over time (lon, lat, time) -> (lon, lat), remove cells with no data (land and coastal gaps)
  sst_df <- expand.grid(lon = lon, lat = lat) |>
    mutate(sst = as.vector(apply(thetao, c(1, 2), mean, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
    filter(!is.na(sst))

  # Spline interpolation from 1 deg to ~0.1 deg. Switch linear = TRUE if you get edge artefacts
  interp_out <- akima::interp(x = sst_df$lon, y = sst_df$lat, z = sst_df$sst,
                              xo = seq(min(lon), max(lon), by = 0.1),
                              yo = seq(min(lat), max(lat), by = 0.1),
                              linear = FALSE, extrap = FALSE)

  sst_interp <- expand.grid(lon = interp_out$x, lat = interp_out$y) |>
    mutate(sst = as.vector(interp_out$z)) |>
    filter(!is.na(sst))

  # Clip to model domain
  st_as_sf(sst_interp, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
    st_intersection(domain_sf) |>
    mutate(
      #st_coordinates(.) extracts the coordinate matrix from the spatial object.[, 1] takes the first column (longitude)
      lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
      lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) |>
    st_drop_geometry()
}

sst_gfdl <- sst_domain(gfdl_path)
sst_ipsl <- sst_domain(ipsl_path)
```

## Plot

Colour-blind friendly RdYlBu palette (blue = cool, red = warm).

```{r plot}
coast <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

cb_warm_cool <- c("#313695", "#4575b4", "#74add1", "#abd9e9", "#e0f3f8",
                  "#fee090", "#fdae61", "#f46d43", "#d73027", "#a50026")

#extracts the bounding box of your model domain shapefile
bbox <- st_bbox(domain_sf)

# Create a mask: large bounding box minus the domain
mask_box <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 0, ymin = -50, xmax = 40, ymax = -20), crs = 4326) |>
  st_as_sfc()
mask <- st_difference(mask_box, domain_sf)

plot_sst <- function(sst_plot, esm, tag) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = sst_plot, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = sst),
              width = 0.1, height = 0.1) +
    # Mask everything outside domain
    geom_sf(data = mask, fill = "white", colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = domain_sf, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "grey80", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cb_warm_cool,
      limits = c(16, 24),
      name = expression("SST (" * degree * "C)"),
      na.value = "transparent") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(16, 28, by = 4)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-36, -28, by = 4)) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox["xmin"] - 0.5, bbox["xmax"] + 0.5),
      ylim = c(bbox["ymin"] - 0.5, bbox["ymax"] + 0.5),
      expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = esm, tag = tag, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.tag.position = c(0.035, 0.987),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 9))
}

p_gfdl <- plot_sst(sst_gfdl, "GFDL", "(a)")
p_ipsl <- plot_sst(sst_ipsl, "IPSL", "(b)")

combined <- ggarrange(p_gfdl, p_ipsl,
                      ncol = 2,
                      common.legend = TRUE,
                      legend = "right")
combined
```

## Save

```{r save}
ggsave(paste0(outpath,"Fig1_sst_maps.pdf"), combined, width = 10, height = 5)
```
